About Cavco Cavco is one of the largest designers and builders of manufactured
homes, modular homes, commercial buildings, park model RVs and
vacation cabins. We produce and sell some of the most widely recognized
brand names in the industry including Cavco Homes, Fleetwood Homes,
Industries, Inc. Palm Harbor Homes, Fairmont Homes, Friendship Homes, Chariot
Eagle and Destiny Homes. Standard Casualty Company offers a range of
insurance products for manufactured home owners and CountryPlace
Mortgage supplies a variety of homebuyer financing options.
Commitment, Experience, Stability and Strength
Cavco is publicly traded on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (symbol CVCO). We are
committed to increasing the value of our shareholders’ investment, providing quality,
affordable housing to our customers and offering a rewarding work environment for
our associates. Forbes Magazine selected Cavco as one of the 100 Best Managed
Companies in the U.S. and the company has been listed as one of America’s Best
Small Companies. Cavco Industries is a seven time recipient of the prestigious MHI
Manufacturer of the Year Award in recognition of its innovation, customer service and
long-term stability.

Dear Fellow Shareholders,
The extraordinary challenges of the past year demanded cohesiveness, flexibility, and
commitment from everyone at Cavco. The year started with concerns about whether there
would be any meaningful demand and ended with unprecedented order rates and backlogs.
Initially, there were serious questions about whether we could operate at all. However, with
our customers, homebuyers, and employees depending on us, leadership across the company
resolved to continue all operations, as long as we could do so safely. We quickly adjusted
policies and approaches to address the concerns and needs of our employees. As new

all. However, with
our customers, homebuyers, and employees depending on us, leadership across the company
resolved to continue all operations, as long as we could do so safely. We quickly adjusted
policies and approaches to address the concerns and needs of our employees. As new
information came to light and circumstances evolved, we continually reevaluated and adjusted
accordingly.
How did it turn out? I am pleased to say that, against all odds, we set records for revenue and
earnings, and our streak of growing both now stands at eleven straight years. Looking at the
past 5 years, we have grown net revenue and net income at annualized rates of 9.2% and 21.8%
respectively.
The fundamental reason for these results, both this year and over time, is our operating
philosophy that has been consistent for decades. While the approaches predate almost all of
us, our operational principles of local decision-making and accountability, as well as our intense
focus on efficiency and cost management, are deeply ingrained in us and continue to serve us
well.
In light of the challenges of fiscal year 2021, however, these results also attest to the resilience
and perseverance of our people. I’m continually impressed and humbled as I observe the way
the people of Cavco rise to the any occasion. That was never more evident than this year. It was
certainly demonstrated in their response to COVID-19. And it again came to the forefront when
the February Texas freeze personally impacted many of the same Cavco people who found
ways to keep us going despite their challenges at home. Time and again, the people of Cavco do
whatever it takes because we’re driven to help people buy and protect homes that improve
their lives.
While the pandemic could have consumed our full attention, a supportive Board of Directors,
great operational leadership, and our strong balance sheet enabled us to remain focused on
long-term value creation without pause or hesitation. We invested in our plants to increase
capacity and product flexibility. We also made the decision to add a new park model production
facility in Glendale, AZ. Now well into the development phase, this project will not only increase
our park model capability, but will also improve efficiency and productivity in our Goodyear, AZ
factory by

in our plants to increase
capacity and product flexibility. We also made the decision to add a new park model production
facility in Glendale, AZ. Now well into the development phase, this project will not only increase
our park model capability, but will also improve efficiency and productivity in our Goodyear, AZ
factory by focusing that operation on producing HUD-code homes. And most importantly, we
made significant investments in our people through benefits improvements, increased
production employee wages, and a new company-wide leadership development program that
is already showing strong results.

With excessive backlogs and continuing strong order rates, we leave the year with a clear need
to increase capacity and production. We expect high levels of demand to persist based on the
dramatic housing deficit created by over a decade of undersupply. There will be inevitable
demand cycles driven by macro-economic shifts. However, over time, more affordable housing
is needed, and we intend to play an increasing role in addressing this problem in traditional
markets as well as urban and suburban areas. The low-cost and environmental advantages of
quality, factory-built housing solutions need to be brought to bear in these markets where
manufactured housing has not traditionally been impactful. We intend to lead the way in this
important work.
We have a tremendous opportunity at Cavco to pursue valuable business opportunities, and in
so doing, to address one of the most pressing social issues of our time – affordable housing. We
are convinced that demographics and the housing supply shortage provide the context for us to
continue our growth and make a meaningful impact. It is to that end that each of our 4,700
Cavco team members contributes when they build, sell, fund, and insure someone’s new home.
On behalf of everyone at Cavco, we want to thank you, our owners, for your continued
confidence and support. We look forward to updating you on our progress in fiscal year 2022.
June 23, 2021
